1. Run `npm install --save-dev --save-exact @playwright/test@<latest 1.x>` so package.json gets an exact devDependency and package-lock.json is updated (a person already approved this dependency). Then add `"e2e": "playwright test"` to the package.json scripts. Leave every other script as it is.

2. Create playwright.config.ts at the repo root with defineConfig from @playwright/test: testDir './e2e', one chromium project, baseURL = process.env.BASE_URL ?? `http://localhost:${process.env.PORT ?? 3000}`, fullyParallel false, retries 0, reporter 'list', trace 'retain-on-failure'. Add a webServer block only when BASE_URL is unset: { command: 'npm run dev', url: that baseURL, reuseExistingServer: true, timeout: 180_000, env with PORT }. That way `BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run e2e` runs the same specs against the container without starting dev. No code comments.

3. Create e2e/auth.ts, a typed port of .rivetari/proof-auth.mjs (not imported from it). Constants: DB_KEY 'breathband-console:local-db', COACH {name: /Sign in as Lena Vos/, uid: 'demo-coach'}, ATHLETE {name: /Sign in as Alex Morgan/, uid: 'demo-athlete'}. A shared signInAs(page, persona) goes to '/cloud/login/', clicks the demo-account button, then waits up to 3s for localStorage[DB_KEY].currentUid === uid, and repeats the click until a 90s deadline (then throws an Error naming the persona). After that it waits for the URL to leave /cloud/login. Export signInAsCoach(page) and signInAsAthlete(page). No comments.

4. Create e2e/smoke.spec.ts with two tests. (1) Coach: signInAsCoach, expect the URL to be /cloud/, goto '/cloud/athletes/', expect heading level 1 'Athletes' and region 'Athletes' (roster pane, Roster.tsx:72/80) to be visible. (2) Athlete: signInAsAthlete, expect the URL pathname '/cloud/' and region 'Latest Total Breath Score' (AthleteOverview.tsx:79) to be visible. Use generous expect timeouts so the first dev compile has time to finish.
5. Add Playwright output to .gitignore under '# testing': /test-results/, /playwright-report/, /blob-report/, /playwright/.cache/.

6. Check that vitest still ignores e2e/: vitest.config.mts already sets include to ['src/**/*.test.ts'], so no edit is needed. Confirm by running `npm run test -- related --run e2e/smoke.spec.ts e2e/auth.ts` and checking that no e2e spec is collected.
7. Install the browser with `npm exec -- playwright install chromium`, then run `PORT=5178 npm run e2e` (the worktree's port) and confirm both smoke tests pass against the dev server it starts.

8. Run `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck`. tsconfig includes **/*.ts, so e2e/ and playwright.config.ts get typechecked against @playwright/test types. Fix any issues in the new files only, without suppressions, without touching tsconfig/eslint config, and without adding comments.
9. Review the diff: only e2e/**, playwright.config.ts, package.json, package-lock.json and .gitignore changed. No comments, no suppressions, no .rivetari edits.
